description: This file is a unit test class named 'AttendanceDaoTest' within the OrangeHRM project, designed to test the functionalities of the AttendanceDao class and related attendance data operations. It includes methods for setup, data population, and multiple test cases for retrieving and validating attendance records, reports, overlaps, and summaries.

classes.name: AttendanceDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing attendance data access objects and related report functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by instantiating the AttendanceDao object and populating test data from YAML fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest attendance record for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Tests fetching attendance records by their ID, including non-existent records.

methods.name: testPunchInOverlapRecords
methods.description: Tests logic preventing punch-in overlaps—throws exceptions when overlaps occur.

methods.name: testPunchOutOverlapRecords
methods.description: Tests logic preventing punch-out overlaps and invalid punch-out times.

methods.name: testAttendanceSummeryReport
methods.description: Validates attendance report generation, filtering by date range, and total hours calculations.

methods.name: testAttendanceList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of attendance lists and total working times based on filters.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Verifies employee attendance summaries for given date ranges and filters.
